HEROES.desc: Heavy armor, a crushing energy hammer, and a barrier that shrugs off anything the bots throw.

weapon.name: Breaker Hammer
weapon.blurb: Slow, crushing melee swings that cleave every bot in front of you.
weapon.perk: 3.4× damage, ignores Armored bot armor, 14-stud reach.

ability.name: Barrier
ability.blurb: Project a shield: take 75% less damage for 6s.

ult.name: Seismic Slam
ult.blurb: Slam the ground: a shockwave hits every bot in front of you and stuns them.

HEROES.desc: A deep-sea salvage diver in pressure armor. Drags bots into reach, holds the line, and makes the siege robot roll faster.

weapon.name: Tidebreaker
weapon.blurb: A heavy chain whip with an anchor hook on the end. Lashes out further than any other melee.

ability.name: Tether
ability.blurb: Hook the bot you're facing, drag it to you and stun it for 1.5s.

ult.name: Undertow
ult.blurb: Open a whirlpool where you aim: it drags every bot in and holds them there, crushing them for 4s.

HEROES.desc: A disciplined all-rounder with a reliable pulse carbine. Easy to pick up, never out of place.

ability.name: Overdrive
ability.blurb: +50% fire rate and instant reload for 5s.

ult.name: Strike Beacon
ult.blurb: Call an orbital strike where you aim: huge damage to every bot in the blast.

HEROES.desc: Blinks through space and hoses targets with twin rapid-fire pistols. Never stops moving.

weapon.name: Burner SMG
weapon.blurb: Very fast fire, big magazine, low damage per shot.

ability.name: Blink
ability.blurb: Dash 18 studs in the direction you're moving. 3 charges.

ult.name: Time Surge
ult.blurb: For 6s: triple fire rate, bottomless magazine and +40% move speed.

HEROES.desc: A hooded brawler with a scattergun that shreds anything in arm's reach.

weapon.name: Reaper Scattergun
weapon.blurb: 8 pellets per shot. The closer you are, the harder it hits.
weapon.perk: Full damage within 8 studs, +25% point blank, 35% at 30+.

ult.name: Death Spiral
ult.blurb: Spin for 3s, shredding every bot around you. Take 50% less damage while spinning.

HEROES.desc: Patient, lethal, and always aiming for the head. Every shot is a big number.

weapon.name: Longbow Rail
weapon.perk: Up to +50% damage on targets 40+ studs away.

ability.name: Deadeye
ability.blurb: Your next 5 hits are guaranteed critical hits.

ult.name: Lockdown
ult.blurb: Lock on to every bot in sight, then fire: massive damage to each one.

HEROES.desc: A falconer of the high ramparts. Grapples onto anything, fires bolts that burst, and drops out of the sky.

weapon.name: Talon Crossbows
weapon.blurb: Heavy bolts that stick in and burst after a moment, hitting everything nearby.

ability.name: Grapple Line
ability.blurb: Fire a line at any surface you aim at and zip to it.

ult.name: Talon Dive
ult.blurb: Leap high into the air, then slam down: huge damage to every bot where you land.

HEROES.desc: Carries the fire everywhere she goes. Everything she touches keeps burning after she's moved on.

weapon.name: Cinder Projector
weapon.blurb: A short-range stream of fire. Bots keep burning after you stop.
weapon.perk: Hits set bots burning for +35% damage over time.

ability.name: Firebreak
ability.blurb: Throw down a patch of fire in front of you. Bots walking through it burn.

ult.name: Inferno
ult.blurb: Blast a huge cone of fire for 3s: every bot caught takes heavy damage, panics and burns.

HEROES.desc: Builds what the fight needs. Nails that ricochet, a sentry in every pocket, and turrets that never sleep.

weapon.name: Nail Driver
weapon.blurb: A rapid nail gun. Every nail ricochets into another bot nearby.
weapon.perk: Hits bounce to a second bot for 40%.

ability.name: Pocket Sentry
ability.blurb: Drop a mini-turret that shoots the nearest bot for 12s.

ult.name: Overclock Field
ult.blurb: For 10s your turrets fire 3× faster, you fire 50% faster, and a free Pocket Sentry drops.

HEROES.desc: Every bot has a price. Marks the valuable targets, takes a cut of every kill, and turns a fight into a payday.

weapon.name: Appraiser
weapon.blurb: A precise revolver: slow, heavy shots with big crits.

ability.name: Mark Asset
ability.blurb: Mark the bot you're facing: for 10s it pays 3× Credits and 3× Scrap when it dies.

ult.name: Jackpot
ult.blurb: For 8s every kill pays 3× Credits, and you fire 25% faster.

HEROES.desc: A haloed field medic who outlasts everything. Nothing keeps her down for long.

weapon.name: Seraph Caster
weapon.blurb: Accurate semi-rapid bolts that mend you.

ability.name: Renew
ability.blurb: Heal 80 HP over 2s and move 30% faster.

ult.name: Sanctuary
ult.blurb: For 10s: you're invulnerable, and you and nearby allies deal 2× damage and earn 2× Credits.

HEROES.desc: A rogue alchemist who drinks the fight. Her siphon drains bots to keep her alive, and her orbs keep the squad going.

weapon.name: Siphon Gauntlet
weapon.blurb: A short-range draining stream that locks on easily and heals you as it hits.
weapon.perk: Never reloads. Every hit heals you 1.2 HP.

ability.name: Bloom Orb
ability.blurb: Throw an orb that bounces around for 6s, draining bots it passes and healing you and allies nearby.

ult.name: Confluence
ult.blurb: For 7s project a long siphon beam that pierces every bot in a line and heals you as it drains.

OnFire.b: Chain kills without getting hit to build heat. Heat multiplies kill Credits up to 2.5×.

Ultimate.b: Damage and kills charge your hero's ultimate. Press Q when it's ready.

Redeploy.b: Cash in Credits for permanent Redeploy points and Rank XP.

CargoBay.b: Cargo never resets. Spend it (C) on permanent upgrades that boost everything.

Payload.b: Escort the payload through the Main Hall. Checkpoints pay Cargo, Credits and Rank XP.

Turrets.b: Bots drop Scrap. Build turrets at the glowing sockets to fight alongside you.

Mastery.b: Kills level up the hero you play. Pick a minor perk at level 2 and a major perk at level 3.

Bounties.b: WANTED bots appear every few minutes. Take them down for Bounty Marks.

Control.b: Capture the active point for Competitive Points. The point moves after each capture.

Runes.b: Stand on an altar in the Armory to roll. Every tier you collect boosts you forever.

Promotion.b: Promote to Silver: reset your Redeploy progress for Skill Rating and a new ladder.

Sturmfeste.b: A storm-lashed castle town whose Sentinels, Knights and Wardens pay far more.

Push.b: Escort the siege robot to the throne. Checkpoints pay Crowns; your best distance is a permanent Credits boost.

Mobility.b: Parkour runs pay Momentum. Spend it on double jump, dash, wall-run and the grapple hook.

Research.b: Spend Crowns on permanent research. The timers keep running while you're offline.

Trials.b: Challenge runs at the Tourney Yard. Beat the handicap for permanent rewards and automation.

TIPS: Redeploy points never reset between runs. The first few Redeploys pay back fastest, so don't sit on a big pile of Credits.
Cargo upgrades are permanent and boost every run. Spend Cargo as soon as you have it.
Chaining kills without taking a hit builds heat up to 2.5× Credits. Healers and tanks keep the streak alive longest.
Runes only roll while you stand on an altar (or anywhere with Auto Rune). Idle on one while you plan upgrades.
You get 1 Ticket every 5 minutes in game. Spend them on permanent Boosts before potions.
Start research before you log off
Research Lab timers keep running while you're offline, so queue the longest project last.
Marks and Competitive Points, and everything you buy with them, never reset.
Every rank is a new hero
Each rank up gives a Hero Token. Try every role: a tank changes how the Payload and Push play.

heroes: Broker
Jackpot triples kill Credits for 8s, and Mark Asset turns any tough bot into a 3× payout.
Solace
Sanctuary doubles damage and Credits for the whole squad, and lifesteal keeps her On Fire.
Rivet
Ricocheting nails hit two bots at once, and Overclock Field triples your turrets' fire rate.
Ember
Burn keeps ticking on every bot she touches. Inferno clears whole packs.
Vesper
Never reloads and heals on every hit. Confluence pierces a whole line of bots.
Longshot
Lockdown hits every bot in sight for 12×. Best against tanky Silver bots.
Bulwark
Seven-ray cleave ignores Armored bot armor. Unkillable behind Barrier.
Kestrel
Splash bolts are strong on groups, and the grapple reaches parkour shortcuts.
Vanguard
Solid everywhere. Strike Beacon's 14× blast is great for packed spawns.
Anchor
Undertow groups bots for your team, and the 26-stud whip is the longest melee.
Havoc
Huge point-blank damage, but you need to get close to every bot.
Flicker
Fun and fast, but 0.55× damage per shot falls off once bots get armor.

PATCHES.title: Runes, Armory & Shop
items: New Armory room behind the Training Hub with the Rune of Valor and Rune of Fortune altars.
Runes rebuilt: stand on an altar to roll. Every tier grows a permanent bonus up to [MAX].
Rune of the Tempest altar in the Sturmhorn Tavern. Global Runes give every player in the server free rolls.
New Shop with Tickets (1 every 5 minutes you play), permanent Boosts, potions, bundles and codes.
Bounty Marks, Competitive Points and their upgrades are now permanent.
Roblox Premium members get +10% on every currency.
The Control Point is now a ring on the ground that fills as you capture.

PATCHES.title: Grapple & feel pass
items: Grapple now lands you on top of perches instead of flinging you off them.
Bot shots now come out of their weapons and hands.
Capture ring reads upright from any angle.

PATCHES.title: Twelve heroes
items: Six new heroes: Anchor, Kestrel, Ember, Rivet, Broker and Vesper.
Free choice: every rank up grants a Hero Token for any hero.
First-person arms now match your hero's model.

PATCHES.title: Sturmfeste
items: Silver ranks unlock Sturmfeste, a storm-lashed castle town with Sentinels, Knights and Wardens.
Siege Push, the Mobility tree with parkour courses, the Research Lab and Trials.
